production.description: Qualified, operator-safe by default, and appropriate for default navigation.

qualified-with-waiver.description: Operationally credible, but still carrying documented caveats, qualification limits, or deployment waivers.

beta.description: Functionally substantial, but still missing closure, consistency, or enough operational proof for default trust.

experimental.description: Exploratory, incomplete, or weakly validated. Must never be presented as routine operator workflow.

hardware-blocked.description: Depends on unavailable hardware, environment, or qualification evidence and should be hidden or explicitly blocked in normal operation.

subsystems.name: Core audio engine and realtime runtime
subsystems.reason: Real implementation depth and latency intent exist, but stability and measurement discipline still need hardening before default production trust.

subsystems.name: Runtime profiles and RT hardening
subsystems.reason: The model is credible and operationally meaningful, but release confidence still depends on stronger evidence gates.

subsystems.name: AVB/TSN transport and routing
subsystems.reason: AVB has real implementation depth and qualification material, but still carries rollout and readiness caveats.

subsystems.name: Tesira control and fleet workflows
subsystems.reason: The surface is broad and serious, but API consistency, error contracts, and operator closure are not finished.

subsystems.name: MIDI Hub and MIDI v2 workflows
subsystems.reason: MIDI depth is substantial, but reliability hardening, information architecture, and contract discipline still lag the breadth of controls.

subsystems.name: Cluster deployment and orchestration
subsystems.reason: Cluster capabilities are meaningful, but they expose too much operational power without a mature auth or failure contract.

subsystems.name: Snapshots, sessions, presets, and exchange flows
subsystems.reason: Useful and implemented, but still part of a broader control plane that overstates maturity and lacks cohesive workflow framing.

subsystems.name: MPX-1 integration
subsystems.reason: Feature depth is real, but qualification and operator-proof closure are still incomplete.

subsystems.name: PipeWire diagnostics and audio path tooling
subsystems.reason: The tooling is valuable, but the recovery path and measurement contract still need hardening.

subsystems.name: NAM/IR/Soundfont acquisition and scraper-driven libraries
subsystems.reason: These flows expand maintenance surface area and content breadth, but they are not central enough or governed enough to present as default operator workflows.

subsystems.name: JUCE-GRID signal-flow editing and routing workflows
subsystems.reason: JUCE-GRID is now the sole supported editor path, but workflow closure, validation depth, and dense-control polish still keep it below operator-safe default trust.

subsystems.name: LCD and dedicated hardware panels
subsystems.reason: These flows are meaningful only when the corresponding hardware and qualification evidence are present.

rules: Experimental items must carry an explicit label in navigation and page headers.
Hardware-blocked items must explain the missing dependency and should be hidden unless the required hardware or mode is detected.
Qualified-with-waiver items may appear in default navigation only if the linked waiver/evidence documentation is available.
Beta items may appear in advanced navigation, but not as equal-priority peers to operator-safe workflows.

maintenance_acceptance_criteria: Every new major subsystem or page family must declare one canonical maturity state before entering default navigation.
Changing a subsystem maturity state requires updating both this matrix and the linked evidence/worklist item in the same change.
No experimental or hardware-blocked surface may appear in default navigation without an explicit exception note and linked evidence.
UI labels must use the exact state names from this matrix instead of ad-hoc synonyms.
